title: Bash best practice for LLM authors (bashqueues-grounded)
purpose: Counter the disproportionately sloppy bash that comes out of LLM corpora by giving an authoring LLM the semantics-backed good form this project demonstrates at scale: correct strict-mode scope, quoting and glob safety, typed stdout/stderr, atomic writes that are verified before publish, and the fail-closed doctrine where output is data and evidence is never acceptance.
